method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Builds arena pregame after common lobby/draft/quickplay setup and Arena model preparation. Find-match is gated by party leadership, leaver lockout and client count; custom game, rank banner, arena-event buttons and host activity remain separate predicates/actions. Lobby and event model watchers update state/prompts/header/draft, with PC redirect navigation at the end. Arena naming does not settle original HMH membership; all branch-specific enum/settings/provider limits remain conditional.
